title: Q-AUDIT-clock-measured: fm-loop-unmeasured failing (fail): Give the clock a route this host can read (a health field, a workflow, a token), so /demo and /live show its real status.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe clock-measured
**Status:** closed

Failure mode `fm-loop-unmeasured` detected by `clock-measured`, failing since 2026-11-26T16:03:02Z.
Evidence: criticality-loop: unmeasured (no CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN on this host and no health route declared)
replication-ledger-beat: unmeasured (RuntimeError: /health has no last_beat_minutes_ago)

Signature: 3b0aedd1b0a5 (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: a loop's clock has no reading in the published record (no route that can read its beats from this host)
Remedy: Give the clock a route this host can read (a health field, a workflow, a token), so /demo and /live show its real status.
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe clock-measured

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T22:05:16Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
